title: TLS between the App Connector and the log receiver
aliases: app connector enrollment certificate trust store

prose.text: TLS on the stream is optional and mutual, and its trust is set up outside the receiver object.

checks.do: That the receiver supports TLS and presents a client certificate from a public root CA when TLS Encryption is on.
That the receiver's trust store holds the App Connector's enrollment certificate.
That a trust problem is fixed on the receiver or connector, not in the receiver object, which carries only a TLS flag.

mutual-tls-optional.statement: Mutual TLS between the log receiver and the App Connector can be enabled when configuring a log receiver, and LSS traffic flows between them only after mutual authentication is established, which requires them to exchange certificates.

quotes: It is possible to use mutual TLS encryption between the log receiver and the App Connector, which you can enable when configuring a log receiver.
LSS traffic only occurs between the App Connector and the log receiver after mutual authentication is established.
This requires them to exchange certificates.

tls-default-off.statement: TLS Encryption is disabled by default on a receiver and requires the receiver to support TLS communication.

quotes: To use this setting, the log receiver must support TLS communication.
By default, this setting is disabled.

receiver-requirements.statement: The log receiver must support TLS, must have a client certificate for mutual TLS that uses a public root CA, and must validate the chain of trust to the App Connector's enrollment certificate, for example by holding that certificate in its trust store.

quotes: Has a client certificate for mutual TLS encryption that uses a public root CA.
Validates the chain of trust to the App Connector's enrollment certificate.
The log receiver must have a certificate signed by a public root certificate authority (CA).
One way to enable the log receiver to validate the chain of trust is to add the App Connector's enrollment certificate in the log receiver's certificate trust store.

connector-trust.statement: The App Connector receives a root certificate automatically during deployment and is designed to trust log receiver certificates signed by the global public root CAs or by custom root CAs used as its enrollment certificate.

quotes: App Connector: Automatically receives a root certificate during deployment.

The App Connector is designed to trust log receiver certificates that are either signed by the global public root CAs, or signed by custom root CAs that are used as the App Connector's enrollment certificate.

tls-flag-only.statement: The receiver object in the Go SDK, the Python SDK model and the Terraform schema carries only a boolean useTls: it has no CA, certificate or peer-verification attribute.

quotes: self.use_tls = config["useTls"] if "useTls" in config else False

tls-flag-only.conditions: Absence claim: the Go LSSConfig struct, the Python LSSConfig model and the Terraform config schema were read in full and hold no attribute for a CA, certificate or peer verification.
